data.action: 戴遮阳帽站在海边回眸
data.description: 【圣园未花 · 夏日海滩的可爱泳装】阳光灿烂的圣三一专属海滩上，未花换上了可爱的粉白荷叶边比基尼，戴着草帽在浪花边欢快地蹦跳。洁白的羽翼在海风中舒展，金眸在波光中闪耀——「老师快看快看！这套泳装可爱吗？今天一整天，老师的视线都不准从未花身上移开哦☆」
data.promptProse: Mika skips along the Trinity beach surf in her white-and-pink frilled swimsuit and pastel pareo, lifting her wings with the sea breeze. Her sun visor shades her smiling face in a backlit medium view. White foam curls around her feet before the water extends toward the horizon. Strong summer sunlight outlines her pink hair and wing feathers, while pale sand reflects soft brightness onto the shaded swimsuit fabric.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 夏日海滩的可爱泳装
